summary: Final ~60s segment (8/8) of a raw Maude Studio screen recording: opens mid-turn with the AI assistant chat finishing an autonomous crop/background-removal cleanup on a football 'MVP' poster (mvp-test canvas), briefly surfaces the Inspector's Photo tab with a clear 'BACKGROUND: applied / redo' badge and the full adjustment-slider stack, then follows the user manually fixing a stat-label typo (tackly -> tackels, with an inline suggestion chip and a color-swatch toolbar) before one inline edit fails with a 'dynamic content' error toast, and closes on a clean zoomed-out pairing of the finished poster beside its isolated background-removed cutout while the assistant chat confirms the removal is 'Resolved'.
